about: What the as-data gate scans (scripts/as-data/check.mjs): ALL of src/**/*.ts (no .d.ts). `globs`: relative to the repo, ** crosses folders, * does not. `exclude`: globs removed from scope. Three tiers: (1) a file with no baseline row starts at zero (the live-zone files under src/zone and src/fight/world*.ts, open-fight.ts, zone-loop*.ts were clean when the gate began and stay so); (2) `legacy`: files with a per-literal count in baseline.json `counts` (V1 donor code), each literal may only go down; (3) every other file with hits has a per-kind TOTAL in baseline.json `totals` (number | label | compare | name-compare | data-id), which may only go down: a PR that removes hard-coded values runs `npm run check:as-data -- --write-baseline` to lower it. Whole-file exemptions (baked geometry tables) live in allow.json `files`, each with a category and a reason.
